## Overview
- Link the associated issue (e.g., Closes #123) and summarize the objective of this change.

## Implementation
- Outline the major code paths, configuration updates, and automation that were introduced.

## Validation
- Describe how you validated the change locally or in lower environments.
- Include screenshots or logs when useful.

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added or updated when appropriate
- [ ] Documentation updated or not required
- [ ] Labels applied (`enhancement`, `codex`, etc. when applicable)
- [ ] Stakeholders notified or not required

## Evidence
- Attach runbooks, metrics, screenshots, or links that demonstrate readiness for merge.
